scope: Static audit of frozen v2 session harness source; no benchmark or new control execution

findings.issue: No type, finiteness or nonnegative/positive validation for timing and RSS fields; malformed negative/NaN numbers can retain pass and enter ratios. Request snapshot labels are not checked against fixed sequence.
findings.requested_fix: Validate numerical fields and exact request/snapshot mapping before accepting a row.

findings.issue: Measurement observables are compared only within measured A/B rows, not to successful fresh-session control observables; common drift in both arms can retain pass.
findings.requested_fix: Compare each measurement observable_digest to the corresponding successful control key(case,capacity,request).

findings.issue: The tool computes scores from in-memory rows but only hashes rows.jsonl on disk; an altered disk row can be sealed without rechecking it equals the measured rows used in scoring.
findings.requested_fix: Reload raw rows, verify equality/shape/order/command against the in-memory execution records before retaining a successful result and scores.

retained_strengths: Frozen runner/harness/binary/fixture/tool/environment/host identity checked before and after
Fresh-session control compares observable report, diagnostics and scalar interfaces
Control logs replay Verify counts, raw stderr, record ordering and commands
Separate initialization/edit-copy/request/process costs and explicit Verify-only scope
limitations: Source-hash binding only; files not yet committed
No independent TypedIR/native equivalence is supplied by this harness
No performance claim from static audit
